items.title: Red Holloway interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995
items.q: I remember many times when I first joined him, I said, “Well when we gonna rehearse?” “Oh I don’t have rehearsals.”

ctx.x: I remember, did you make a record with him that had no drummer on it or something? I remember hearing a record of his, but I remember your name on it.

Uh, I don’t remember making one with no drummer, but we did do some peculiar things. I remember many times when I first joined him, I said, “Well when we gonna rehearse?” “Oh I don’t have rehearsals.” I said, “What? You don’t have no rehearsals?” I said, “What am I going to play?” “Oh you’ll find something.” I asked Blue Mitchell, I say, “Man, what am I gonna play?” “Oh don’t worry about it, you’ll find something.” He says the reason he doesn’t rehearse is because he likes for it to be spontaneous.
